vibe_rationale: Curated local-brand market (about 250 makers chosen from around 3,000 submissions) where brands sit inside the experience, though it is mall-hosted and commercial.
fit_notes: Large, style-led Jakarta crowd (216,000 across two weekends in 2026) with a proven partner model and health-adjacent partners already present (Kahf, Derma Scalp Expert). A curated wellness stall or lounge would fit, but no partnership contact is published, so access runs through vendor submissions.
